input.goal: Find the date of the 2026 Dublin Marathon (Irish Life Dublin Marathon). Check the official site or a reliable source and report the exact date and start time if listed.

content.text: [happy] The 2026 Dublin Marathon is on Sunday 25 October, with a start at 8:45. That's six days from now, so if you're running it, the taper is over and it's time to stop fiddling with your playlist.
